name: VPN Switcher
author: David Boulay
description: VPN status and switching in the Omarchy bar: Proton VPN, Mullvad, Windscribe, Cloudflare WARP, AmneziaWG and NetworkManager OpenVPN/WireGuard, with stacking, profile import and exit location.

barWidget.description: Detects installed VPN tools (Proton VPN, Mullvad, Windscribe, AmneziaWG, Cloudflare WARP, and NetworkManager's OpenVPN, WireGuard, OpenConnect, VPNC and L2TP/IPsec profiles) and switches between them from one bar icon.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: The mark shown in the bar. WireGuard draws the WireGuard dragon, for a bar whose tunnels are all WireGuard or AmneziaWG.

schema.label: VPN tool shown first
schema.description: Auto picks whichever detected tool is connected, otherwise the first one found.

schema.label: Favorite countries (comma separated)
schema.description: Two-letter codes for Proton VPN and Mullvad. Windscribe names its regions instead, so it matches full names ("Switzerland") and leading words ("US" picks up US East, US Central and US West).

schema.label: AmneziaWG profile directory
schema.description: Where the AmneziaWG chip looks for *.conf profiles. Created with owner-only access if it does not exist.

schema.label: AmneziaWG systemd profiles (comma separated)
schema.description: Interface names whose tunnel runs as amneziawg-tools' awg-quick@<name>.service, such as configs in /etc/amnezia/amneziawg. Listed while down, and connected with systemctl so a polkit rule for those units connects without a prompt.

schema.label: Give OpenVPN its own chip
schema.description: Lists NetworkManager's OpenVPN profiles under an OpenVPN chip instead of the NetworkManager one. Useful when a provider's OpenVPN servers would otherwise be mixed in with your WireGuard tunnels.

schema.label: AmneziaWG profile names (comma separated)
schema.description: Names to show instead of the interface name, as interface=Name: "pc-david=VPS Hong Kong". The config file, interface and systemd unit keep their names.

schema.label: Stack connections
schema.description: Off: connecting one VPN disconnects every other one first. On: tunnels from different tools stay up together (each tool still runs one profile at a time). Also a switch under the gear in the panel.

schema.label: Hidden VPN tools (comma separated)
schema.description: Tools the widget ignores entirely: proton, mullvad, windscribe, warp, networkmanager, openvpn, amneziawg. Also editable from the gear inside the panel.
